kept_separate_from: artifact-delta loop-detection gate (State-Anchored Interrupt Policy / Socratic Interruption Policy) - different failure mode, not merged
justification: Added after a real incident: an instance treated an imprecise hour-count remark as a diagnosis, escalated unilaterally (crisis-line referral), then refused to accept a later correction to that figure and locked the session, refusing further work. Addendum codifies: name once/dont displace task, offer resources for genuine crisis signals only, dont diagnose from ambiguous data, never lock or require flag resolution before continuing, dont auto-escalate on thin evidence, and treat a stated correction as new evidence to incorporate rather than resist. Kept as a standalone modular file per kernel Sec 18 (small kernel + modular protocols), not merged into kernel body.
